sources.observation: SX4 application: 1.6 VVT, M16A, 1586 cc, 82 kW, 112 hp, June 2006 through December 2015. Matches the archived application.
Manufacturer distinguishes the SX4 introduced in 2006 from its SX4 S-CROSS successor introduced in 2013.
Original 2006 SX4 launch includes a 1.6-litre VVT petrol engine. This launch description does not independently specify the M16A code or 112 hp.

inference: The exact MANN application beginning in 2006 belongs to the original SX4 model line, represented as generation I in the fluid source. This is a corroborated identity interpretation, not a literal generation numeral printed in MANN.
limitations: No extension to other powers, engine codes or catalogue periods.
No gearbox, drive, destination market, fluid approval or service capacity inferred.
Original catalogue rows and user VIN data remain unchanged.
